observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor public plaza in Paris with the Eiffel Tower in the background, daytime
observation.dancers: Five female dancers and one male dancer, mixed group
observation.formation_and_space: Horizontal line facing forward, occasionally spreading or shifting positions
observation.posture: Athletic posture with bent knees, upright torso, body weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and bouncing on the beat, quick weight shifts, foot tapping and sliding
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move dynamically with the rhythm, waving, pointing, and holding hands at times
observation.hips_and_torso: Bouncing torso with hip movement and swaying on the beat
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level squats and small jumps, occasional turns
observation.costume_and_props: Casual athletic wear including crop tops, shorts, and sneakers; one dancer has long green braids
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement details are obscured by quick camera cuts and wide angles.

signature_moments.what: Synchronized bouncing with arms raised and bent at elbows, stepping side to side in a line
Quick foot taps while shifting weight and moving arms in coordination with the beat
Deep knee bend with torso dipping forward and arms extending outward
Pairing up and jumping while moving in a circle around each other
